projectState.summary: Byte 7 is implemented and ready for Claude review. Players now have compact thinking profiles with disposition traits and memory fragments; src/thought-seeds.ts builds deterministic in_song_short thought seeds from listening, taste, recent motif, focus player, and selected memory context. The app exposes a Thoughts inspector section and window.thinking.getSeeds(). No Ollama, persistence, transport behavior, taste behavior, or session behavior changes were added.
